title: Preferences dialog shell
summary: SettingsDialog: a modal Preferences dialog with a collapsible left rail of section tabs, one scrolling pane of foldable section cards, a scroll spy and a wire from the active tab. Add a section by registering a name, an icon and groups of rows.
description: `SettingsDialog extends Dialog` (frontend/src/ui/app-dialogs.ts) is built once at start, appended to #overlay-root, and shown and hidden, never rebuilt. The constructor defines four closures: `grp(label, ...rows)` makes a titled group card (`section.cv-prefs-group` with `h3.cv-prefs-label`, relabelled on language change), `nt(text)` a note, `cols(...rows)` a responsive grid of rows, and `add(name, ...groups)` registers a section: it builds the rail tab (`button.cv-prefs-railtab`, icon from the `railIcons` map, English name in `data-section`) and the pane card (`section.cv-prefs-page.cv-prefs-sec` with a head button that folds the body), and stores the card in `this.sections`. After all `add` calls a loop re-appends tabs and cards in one fixed order; the `add` call order must equal the display order because the scroll spy treats the last key as the last card. `show(section?, live?)` re-reads the preferences, sets every pre-built row, refreshes async parts, opens the shell and scrolls to the section. `showSection`, `markSection`, `scrollToSection`, `foldSection`, `queueSpy`, `queueWire` and `drawWire` keep rail, pane and the SVG wire in step. `change(patch)` merges a patch into the preferences without overwriting what tool options and dialogs remembered meanwhile, saves, and calls `onPrefs`. Rows come from the control-row builders and from panels/page-prefs.ts (`PagePrefsRows`), built once and patched in place so nothing flashes. The rail collapse is remembered in localStorage (formvis.prefsRailCollapsed) inside try/catch. The stylesheet block is the `cv-prefs-*` selectors in frontend/src/styles/dialogs.css (the dialog frame, rail, tabs, wire, port, cards, groups, notes, the column grid and the row overrides inside the dialog). A port keeps the shell and replaces the section list and the rows; the formvis engine, GPU, generative and plug-in rows are formvis-specific.
statusReason: proposed for the owner to confirm; the S7 exit slot for the Preferences dialog shell

exports.signature: export class SettingsDialog extends Dialog { constructor(onPrefs: (p: Prefs) => void) }
exports.doc: Edit > Preferences (Ctrl+,): sections on the left, each section's settings on the right, kept on this device. onPrefs puts a change into effect.
Re-reads the preferences, sets every row, opens the dialog and scrolls to the section; live docks it to the right and lets clicks reach the canvas.
Patches the engine status note in place.
The rows of the small preference pages (Cursors, Transparency and Gamut, Units and Rulers, Type, Enhanced Controls, Plug-ins), built once and filled by set when the dialog opens.

commands.doc: Opens the Preferences dialog; one prefs-<id> command per section opens it at that section.

renameables: engine, GPU, generative and plug-in rows

invariants.text: Every row is built once in the constructor and patched in place when the dialog opens; the dialog is never rebuilt and no innerHTML is assigned on a live container.
The add() call order equals the display order, or the scroll spy picks the wrong card at the end of the scroll.
Section names are the English identity in data-section; every visible label goes through t() and is repainted on language change.
change(patch) re-reads the stored preferences and keeps tool options, dialog values and What's New state so it never overwrites what was remembered while the dialog was open.
The rail collapse state is read and written inside try/catch.
